question: Which team won the 2025 edition of the Women's Premier League (Cricket) 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Mumbai Indians** emerged as the winners of the **2025 edition of the Women's Premier League (Cricket)**, showcasing their dominance and consistent performance in the tournament.
 
• The Women's Premier League (WPL) is a **professional cricket league for women** in India, modeled after the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The Mumbai Indians, known for their **strong team composition** and experienced players, have consistently performed well in past tournaments.
 
• The 2025 WPL final witnessed a thrilling match where the Mumbai Indians defeated their opponents to secure the championship title.
 
• The team’s victory was attributed to outstanding performances by key players, strategic gameplay, and effective leadership from the captain and coaching staff.
